public_revenue_training.test_protocol: Separate geographic groups: complete 2025 entity holdout and January-August 2026 future holdout. Last four 2026 forecasts are unobserved and never counted.
public_revenue_training.selection_metric: Validation-only historical-scale-normalized revenue MAE; no test outcomes used
public_revenue_training.limitations: Aggregate service value/turnover is a proxy for revenue, not bank cash receipts. Preliminary single-vintage revisions, COVID-era trade observations, three-month post-break service histories and overlapping service categories limit transfer claims. Geographic partitions keep all categories and parent/child observations of a region together.

selection.expense_training: Actual generated outflows from synthetic training businesses only; no public expense/default labels
selection.transfer_selection_metric: Same 60 held-out synthetic validation businesses, future-12-month net MAE; public candidate chosen separately on geographic validation only

public_calibration.source: Uzbekistan SIAT retail aggregate turnover, CC BY 4.0

test_protocol.capacity_and_schedule_population: Only positive-principal businesses; zero-loan cohorts reported separately
test_protocol.overload_definition: payment > actual future net surplus; a zero payment in a negative-surplus month also counts
test_protocol.annuity_comparator: Same indexed principal, 12-month term and explicitly 0% APR; equal installments
test_protocol.mape_policy: Exclude abs(actual)<1 index. Negative actuals use absolute denominator. MAPE remains unstable near zero and is not the selection metric.

seasonality.ground_truth: Future realised net-flow bottom/top quartiles, not generator seasonal parameters

max_20000_transaction_request.construction: Repeated generated synthetic transaction events; latency-only, not a capacity accuracy test

latency.scope: Single process, warm model, sequential local TestClient. Includes JSON validation, response serialization and durable audit; excludes network/load and train/startup.
